scope: Current next-1000 candidate records and their independent authored members. Excludes site-structures, reusable category models and procedural styles.
limits: Hashes prove existing output integrity, not reconstruction from today’s recipes. No model generation, import, render capture or full source rebuild was performed.
The existing readiness ledger’s ready label includes legacy fidelity approvals. It does not prove that every model meets current medium-fi budgets or that every LOD recipe is current.

Existing reviews bind authoring inputs, not rebuilt GLB bytes. Capture/model byte discrepancies alone do not revoke those reviews or prove missing geometry; they are reported for investigation. The 14-model integrity/LOD intersection is not a new complete-model count.
A current LOD recipe hash does not certify geometry, visual accuracy, real geographic fit or physical phone/laptop performance.
Historical test counts and inspected renders are not new approvals and do not identify the user’s unnamed missing-building issue.
